title: Independent combined migration/test/evidence review: separate four-literal oracle numerator migration preparation
reviewer: NEW independent Opus reviewer (claude-opus-5-5); not a continuation of the certificate reviewers; no fixes, no subreviews, no follow-up launched
verdict_summary: The frozen candidate 3432ac3f changes exactly four numerator literals (main.rs lines 242/293/300/368) and adds only migration evidence, one report and one inserted registry entry. Independent evidence confirms every material claim: the old (133899..) and new (49ed27..) assertion ELFs are byte-identical in all loadable and debug sections except 32 .text bytes that are exactly the four movabs immediates (old literals in the old ELF, new literals in the new ELF), so both come from the same compiler/flags/341-unit dependency closure/sources apart from the patch; the new ELF's qualified build compiled the candidate main.rs. A fresh, sandboxed, minimal-environment rerun of the retained ELFs gives old 12/12 failures (exit 101, panic at the Summary assertion, only numerators differ) and new 12/12 passes, one real selected test per run, at pools 1/8/32, with observed peak OS threads 394/402/426 showing Run::threads(1|8|32) reaching the runtime pools. My own Summary implementation, written from census.rs, reproduces all four digests and unchanged counts, rational weights, inverse symmetry and histograms from the approved historical/current pool-1 captures and from all 48 fresh and author runtime dumps, matching each run's per-diagram census digests. All emitted None/Auto payloads are byte-identical across routes, pools, observer companions and the approved pool-1 captures; the CT None/Auto permutation 109->113,110->109,111->114,112->110,113->115,114->111,115->116,116->112 holds at every route/pool and equals the certified mapping. All 48 observer-mode bindings, the 541-run certificate replay (identical to approved except output paths), 31 fresh approved suite runs, the outer manifest expected failure, the freeze/inventory/receipt hashes, the reproducible PDF/HTML render with detected altered-report controls, and the inherited-only docs gates check out. No blocking finding. Eleven nonblocking notes concern helper portability, binding precision and wording. This is not MAIN or WP3 clearance and does not extend the mathematical certificate beyond pool 1.
